parameters: harness: a fifth more of the proteome

invariants.description: throttle = clamp((ATP - ATP_floor)/(ATP_ref - ATP_floor), 0, 1); J_cap = build_capacity J_ref throttle R_reg; s_build = min(1, J_cap/J_demand_total) (exact up to the 1e-30 mol/s floor)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(throttle, np.clip((cyto__C_ATP - ATP_floor)/(ATP_ref - ATP_floor), 0, 1), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(J_cap, build_capacity*J_ref*throttle*R_reg, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(s_build, np.where(J_demand_total > J_cap, (J_cap + J_eps)/(J_demand_total + J_eps), 1.0), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12)

invariants.description: the pools never spend more than synthesis can: J_build_total <= J_cap (relative 1e-9)
the ATP port takes exactly what the pools use less what catabolism makes: j_ATP = -J_ATP_total = -(J_keep_total + J_build_total + J_prot_total - J_cat) (exact; relative 1e-9 with pools)
invariants.expr: np.allclose(j_ATP_prot, -J_ATP_total, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_ATP_total, J_keep_total + J_build_total + J_prot_total - J_cat, rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: proteolysis and the recycled pool (exact): s_prot = min(1, Q_prot_max/Q_prot_demand_total), phi_aa = N_aa/(K_aa + N_aa), r_aa_cat = N_aa/tau_aa_cat, J_cat = y_aa_cat r_aa_cat / N_A, J_recycled = J_saved_total + J_cat
invariants.expr: np.allclose(s_prot, np.where(Q_prot_demand_total > Q_prot_max, (Q_prot_max + Q_eps)/(Q_prot_demand_total + Q_eps), 1.0), rtol=1e-9, atol=1e-12) and np.allclose(phi_aa, np.maximum(N_aa, 0)/(K_aa + np.maximum(N_aa, 0)), rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-15) and np.allclose(J_cat, y_aa_cat*np.maximum(N_aa, 0)/tau_aa_cat/N_A, rtol=1e-12, atol=0) and np.allclose(J_recycled, J_saved_total + J_cat, rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-30)

invariants.description: amino acids are conserved: N_aa(t) - N_aa(0) = int (Q_aa_rel_total - Q_aa_use_total - r_aa_cat) dt (relative 1e-4: trapezoid integration of the logged fluxes); the proteases never remove more than their capacity, Q_prot_demand_total s_prot <= Q_prot_max
invariants.expr: abs(N_aa[-1] - N_aa[0] - np.trapz(Q_aa_rel_total - Q_aa_use_total - r_aa_cat, t)) <= 1e-4*np.trapz(np.abs(Q_aa_rel_total) + np.abs(Q_aa_use_total) + np.abs(r_aa_cat), t) + 1e-9 and np.all(Q_prot_demand_total*s_prot <= Q_prot_max*(1 + 1e-9) + 1e-9)

bc_sweep.rationale: synthesis capacity from below to well above the two pools' demand; the ATP floor over the range where the cytosol's falling ATP crosses it
